long_description:
Roll out your mat and get ready to stretch, flex, and flow in store.

About this Event

Join us in-store for an energizing private Vinyasa Yoga class led by lululemon Ambassador, Jazmin Tejada. We’ll move, breathe, and flow together—tailored for runners and great cross-training for everyone. Then stick around to mingle with community members over refreshments.

Disclosure: Doors will be locked, so please arrive on time as no one will be let in 15 mins past start time due to safety concerns and not disupting class.
